sourceMarkup:
The '''Gift Box''' is a mechanic that allows you to claim various rewards, such as skins or towers. Rewards can be given to you for completing tasks or given as a gift for purchasing real-life products, like toys. The '''Gift Box''' menu appears in the top right corner of your screen, but only when you have a reward to claim.

==Season Rewards==
[[File:SeasonsGiftBox.png|center|300px|thumb]]

When a season ended, any unredeemeed rewards would be moved to the '''Gift Box''' menu, where they could be claimed after a season has ended. You could not claim any unredeemed rewards from the [[Halloween 2020 Event#Halloween Season Pass|Halloween Season]], [[Frost Invasion Event#Frost Invasion Season Pass|Frost Invasion Season]], [[Solar Eclipse Event#Solar Eclipse Season Pass|Solar Eclipse Season]], [[Season of Love#Season Pass|Season of Love Season]] or [[Duck Hunt Event#Hunting Season Pass|Hunting Season]]. You were able to claim rewards starting with the [[End of Summer Season]]. All unaccepted rewards from before the [[Hexscape Event]] have been automatically claimed from the '''Gift Box'''.

==Bundle Rewards==
[[File:GiftBoxBundles.png|center|125px|thumb]]

Multiple crates have bundle gamepasses, which when purchased will give you specific skins from a crate. These skins will be available to be claimed through the '''Gift Box'''.
